purpose: Fit condition-specific source-anchored orthogonal feature alignment using public unlabeled U only, then freeze before independent V
controls: Reuse completed frozen D0 predictions on exactly the same V records; D1 uses U-fitted alignment and the original six-class default head
source_endpoint: fixed E51 uniform_oe, original4OE MLP and original-baseline-risk source thresholds

alignment.rule: Per branch standardize by frozen source statistics; normalized weighted core class directions M and source prototypes P; R=polar(I+0.5*M.T@P/K); apply standardized raw row vectors by right multiplication
alignment.sample_weight: MSP times learned-branch agreement fraction, normalized within each supported pseudo-class; equal class mass over supported old pseudo-classes
alignment.preserves: Euclidean distances and cosine between standardized branch vectors; not whitened Mahalanobis distances
alignment.identity_fallback: Insufficient reliable core or fused support; cannot be called successful adaptation

evaluation.known_acceptance_objective: maximize subject to rejection and identity protection

budget: One seed, C0/P1 independently reset, one U pass plus closed-form alignment each, D0 predictions reused, D1 V per-sample; at most one added GPU worker at a time
claim_scope: Development only, previously source-evaluated novel TX, no formal query/anonymous registration claim; insufficient/negative result does not trigger threshold tuning or selective rerun
